flora: Conifer cone (small, peltate scales, woody texture)
Needle spray (flat, two-ranked needles, soft and feathery)
Buttressed root (thick, flaring base showing fibrous bark)
Seedling (thin stalk with delicate tufts of needles)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; chunky, fibrous textures for the wood; soft, clumped needles; avoiding sharp angles to maintain the 'animated feature' appeal.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant layout featuring: a close-up of a woody cone, a feathery spray of green needles, a study of the flaring root buttress, and a delicate young seedling.
visual_logic.ground: Dark grey silty mud interspersed with fallen needles and small bits of rotting wood.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, bright, diffused daylight to highlight the intricate patterns of the needles and scales.
